review_type: READ_ONLY_SOURCE_TARGETED_PRELAUNCH; no GPU, model loads, installations or implementation edits

scope.route: F; BF16 full-parameter training of instantiated official text submodel only
scope.lora: BLOCKED_MAPPING_REQUIRES_APPROVAL; no new DeltaNet mapping in this review

findings.finding: The fixed TF5.2 Trainer groups all requires_grad named_parameters once into decay/no-decay groups. adamw_torch resolves to native torch.optim.AdamW with configured lr, beta1/beta2/eps; fused=True is set only for the different adamw_torch_fused enum. Probe asserts original parameter-ID membership exact before and after DS. No concrete TF5.2 API mismatch found; no Trainer.train invocation replaces the manual author-temperature CE.

The official text forward visits every 24 decoder layers, final norm, tied embedding/head. Each DeltaNet forward uses qkv,z,b,a projections, conv1d, A_log, dt_bias, gated norm, out_proj; each FFN and six full-attention blocks are connected. The probe requires all instantiated params trainable, checks every trainable tensor hook called and finite, samples representative attention/FFN/DeltaNet/A_log/norm changes plus all SID rows. Source connectivity is not a runtime nonzero-gradient guarantee.

Official decoder subclasses GradientCheckpointingLayer. gradient_checkpointing_enable forwards use_reentrant=False to torch checkpoint and installs it on decoder layers; training call already uses use_cache=False with no prior cache. The official layer clears any cache kwargs under checkpointing. No architecture replacement or manual detached recurrence is introduced.

findings.area: DS BF16 and native fallback precision
findings.finding: DS BF16 casts instantiated model parameters BF16; native DeltaNet fallback deliberately converts q/k/v/g/beta and recurrence to FP32, returns original activation dtype. A_log.float and a.float guard exponent/softplus. BF16 route therefore includes official FP32 recurrence/math and FP32 author CE/master/moments. Header source F32 scalar/vector tensors may be cast BF16 by load/DS; actual before/after dtypes and finite grads must be confirmed from raw run.

findings.source: modeling_utils.py:3170-3320; conversion_mapping.py:70; probe.py route-F save/reload branch
findings.finding: Official tied mapping is lm_head.weight -> model.embed_tokens.weight. Native safetensors save removes declared alias storage and may reverse original checkpoint prefix conversion; built-in qwen3_5_text conversion supports model.language_model -> model on reload. Helper accepts saved qwen3_5_text config. Probe hashes every state key before save and compares all keys/shapes/dtypes/full hashes after reload on both ranks, with sharing assertion. This is a suitable runtime gate, not evidence it has passed. No optimizer/scheduler/RNG checkpoint is saved or restored.

_is_stateful=True prevents generic default DynamicCache allocation and assisted generation; fixed TF5.2 does not reject ordinary beam search for this flag. Official text forward creates Qwen3_5DynamicCache. Beam search calls cache.reorder_cache, which index_selects all attention KV and linear conv/recurrent state batch axes. prepare_inputs_for_generation and cache_position update retain single-token incremental path. Prefix_allowed_tokens_fn remains standard logits processor input; no source-level requirement to replace beam20, remove callback or change position-only constraints was found.

findings.area: Finite fallback cost and resource gate
findings.finding: CPU receipt confirms official slow torch fallback because fast kernels are absent. Chunk kernel pads to64 and performs63 triangular recurrence-row updates per DeltaNet layer; it can be materially slower than full attention. This is an implementation identity/cost boundary, not a demonstrated compatibility failure. Guard time/memory budgets remain binding, and no optional fast-kernel installation is proposed.

required_real_runtime_gates: official asset SHA/publish complete and original/expanded parameter counts match CPU audit
all actual instantiated trainable tensors receive finite gradients under checkpointing
native AdamW GPU master/moments plus first state-allocation step stay within memory budget
at least one nonzero-LR global step changes SID and representative model parameters and both ranks synchronize
native model-only save and strict all-state reload with preserved tying
eight distinct real users beam20,20 returns, max_new_tokens10, exact per-position callback+EOS and recorded cache failure if any
not_tested: no q35 GPU run performed by this reviewer
no full training-state checkpoint or recovery
no assurance of BF16 numerical stability or throughput from static review alone
conclusion: Read-only pinned-source review identifies no concrete additional engineering incompatibility that justifies speculative changes before the authorized F35 probe. Full-text-submodel scope and official slow fallback must remain explicit. Only actual raw GPU evidence can determine F35 technical terminal status.
